text.tspan: Rising from the Sulu Sea, the Tubbataha
Reefs Natural Park is a marine
species of fish and three hundred corals
fishing and illegal poaching by dedicated
Philippine Navy and Coast Guard patrols...

g.text: Definition: The rich variety of plant and animal life in a natural ecosystem.
"Notice how 'sanctuary' gives context clues about why biodiversity thrives in Tubbataha!"
